mapper.sql: i.id, i.owner_id, i.kind, i.project_id, i.title, i.status, i.revision, i.verification, i.favorite, i.current_version_id, i.version_number, i.created_at, i.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM preparation_item i WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{id}

SELECT i.kind, i.id AS item_id, v.id AS version_id, CASE WHEN i.kind='FACT' AND i.verification='WITHDRAWN' THEN 'WITHDRAWN' WHEN i.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'ARCHIVED' WHEN i.kind='FACT' AND p.id IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.kind='FACT' AND p.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'PROJECT_ARCHIVED' WHEN i.kind='FACT' AND i.verification<>'CONFIRMED' THEN 'UNVERIFIED' WHEN i.current_version_id<>v.id THEN 'SUPERSEDED' ELSE 'CURRENT' END AS state, i.source_generation, p.source_generation AS project_generation FROM preparation_item i JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=#{versionId} LEFT JOIN preparation_item p ON i.kind='FACT' AND p.owner_id=i.owner_id AND p.id=i.project_id AND p.kind='PROJECT' WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{id} AND i.kind=#{kind} AND i.kind IN ('TARGET','PROJECT','FACT')
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expression_basis_review b WHERE b.owner_id=i.owner_id AND b.item_id=i.id AND b.version_id=v.id AND b.version_number=v.version_number AND b.revision=(SELECT MAX(last_basis.revision) FROM expression_basis_review last_basis WHERE last_basis.owner_id=i.owner_id AND last_basis.item_id=i.id AND last_basis.version_id=v.id) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.factVersionIds'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.factVersionIds')) BETWEEN 1 AND 50 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expression_basis_review_fact counted WHERE counted.owner_id=b.owner_id AND counted.review_id=b.id) =JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.factVersionIds')) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preparation_reference counted WHERE counted.owner_id=i.owner_id AND counted.target_item_id=i.id AND counted.target_version_id=v.id) =JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.factVersionIds')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expression_basis_review_fact saved LEFT JOIN preparation_item fact ON fact.owner_id=saved.owner_id AND fact.id=saved.fact_item_id LEFT JOIN preparation_version fixed_fact ON fixed_fact.owner_id=saved.owner_id AND fixed_fact.item_id=saved.fact_item_id AND fixed_fact.id=saved.fact_version_id LEFT JOIN preparation_item project ON project.owner_id=saved.owner_id AND project.id=saved.project_id WHERE saved.owner_id=b.owner_id AND saved.review_id=b.id AND ( saved.item_id<>i.id OR saved.version_id<>v.id OR saved.ordinal>JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.factVersionIds')) OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,CONCAT('$.factVersionIds[',saved.ordinal-1,']')))<>'STRING' OR BINARY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,CONCAT('$.factVersionIds[',saved.ordinal-1,']'))) <>BINARY saved.fact_version_id OR fact.id IS NULL OR fact.kind<>'FACT' OR fact.status<>'ACTIVE' OR fact.verification<>'CONFIRMED' OR fact.current_version_id<>saved.fact_version_id OR fact.project_id<>saved.project_id OR fixed_fact.id IS NULL OR fixed_fact.version_number<>saved.version_number OR BINARY fixed_fact.title<>BINARY saved.title OR fact.source_generation<>saved.source_generation OR project.id IS NULL OR project.kind<>'PROJECT' OR project.status<>'ACTIVE' OR project.source_generation<>saved.project_generation OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM preparation_reference exact_ref WHERE exact_ref.owner_id=i.owner_id AND exact_ref.target_item_id=i.id AND exact_ref.target_version_id=v.id AND exact_ref.source_kind='FACT' AND exact_ref.use_type='FACT_BASIS' AND exact_ref.preparation_source_item_id=saved.fact_item_id AND exact_ref.preparation_source_version_id=saved.fact_version_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM preparation_reference actual_ref WHERE actual_ref.owner_id=i.owner_id AND actual_ref.target_item_id=i.id AND actual_ref.target_version_id=v.id AND (actual_ref.source_kind<>'FACT' OR actual_ref.use_type<>'FACT_BASIS' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expression_basis_review_fact exact_saved WHERE exact_saved.owner_id=b.owner_id AND exact_saved.review_id=b.id AND exact_saved.fact_item_id=actual_ref.preparation_source_item_id AND exact_saved.fact_version_id=actual_ref.preparation_source_version_id))))
mapper.select: SELECT i.kind, i.id AS item_id, v.id AS version_id, CASE WHEN i.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'ARCHIVED' WHEN i.current_version_id<>v.id THEN 'SUPERSEDED' WHEN NOT () THEN 'UNVERIFIED' ELSE 'CURRENT' END AS state, i.source_generation, NULL AS project_generation FROM preparation_item i JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=#{versionId} WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{id} AND i.kind='EXPRESSION'

SELECT r.source_kind, r.preparation_source_item_id AS source_item_id, r.preparation_source_version_id AS source_version_id, r.use_type, v.item_id AS version_item_id, f.kind AS item_kind,v.title,v.version_number,f.project_id FROM preparation_reference r LEFT JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.id=r.preparation_source_version_id LEFT JOIN preparation_item f ON f.owner_id=r.owner_id AND f.id=v.item_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.target_item_id=#{itemId} AND r.target_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 51
SELECT id,item_id,owner_id,version_number,title,content_json,created_at FROM preparation_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{itemId} AND id=#{versionId}
SELECT id,item_id,owner_id,version_number,title,content_json,created_at FROM preparation_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{versionId}

SELECT source_kind, COALESCE(preparation_source_item_id,knowledge_source_item_id) AS source_item_id, COALESCE(preparation_source_version_id,knowledge_source_version_id) AS source_version_id FROM preparation_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND target_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY source_kind,source_item_id,source_version_id

SELECT FROM preparation_item i WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.status='ACTIVE' AND i.kind IN ('TARGET','EXPRESSION') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM preparation_reference r WHERE r.owner_id=i.owner_id AND r.target_item_id=i.id AND r.target_version_id=i.current_version_id AND r.preparation_source_item_id=#{id}) AND i.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY i.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE preparation_item SET favorite=#{favorite},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT target_id,revision FROM preparation_focus WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO preparation_focus (owner_id,target_id,revision) VALUES (#{owner},NULL,0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=owner_id
mapper.update: UPDATE preparation_focus SET target_id=#{targetId},revision=revision+1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND revision=#{expected}
